newsitem.title: USA: RISCORP PRESIDENT AND CFO RESIGN.
newsitem.headline: RISCORP PRESIDENT AND CFO RESIGN.

text.p: RISCORP Inc said on Tuesday James Malone has resigned as president and chief operating officer.
Malone's duties will be assumed by chief executive Frederick Dawson, who also was named president, RISCORP said.

Also, Richard Franz has resigned as senior vice president and chief financial officer and will be replaced by Stephen Rece, senior vice president and head of the company's reinsurance department, RISCORP said.
RISCORP was not immediately available for further comment.
Last week, the company announced plans to reduce its workforce and focus its operations on the managed workers' compensation insurance business.

The company has not yet filed its 10-K annual report for 1996 and its first quarter 10-Q report with the Securities and Exchange Commission. RISCORP declined to disclose a reason for the resignations. Tuesday, 10 June 1997 20:38:39 ENDS nN10239403
